text:
Overview
This series of products are the industrial L3 lite Ethernet switch products independently developed by N-net® for the industrial application scenarios with harsh use environment and high reliability requirements. The products adopt industrial-level high-reliability components and industrial-level hardware structure design. The software is developed based on the mature and reliable software platform with independent intellectual property rights, providing a set of highly reliable industrial Ethernet communication solutions for flexible industrial-level application scenarios. The products meet a wide range of industrial Ethernet standards, and can be widely used in industrial automation, urban rail transit, railway, public transportation, electric power, energy and chemical industry, intelligent buildings and other industrial application scenarios.
This series of products have a variety of product forms including 24*10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ 4 *10G SFP+, 16 *10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ 4 *10G SFP+ models, all models can be selected to support PoE+.
Picture
244TPGM3                                        64TPGM3
Features
Supports L3 routing protocol such as RIP,OSPF;VRRP
6KV surge protection, 6KV contact / 8KV air ESD protection;
Supports working temperature-40℃~75℃;
Supports wall hanging and desktop installation.
